relations: Dante 是 Shiv 的 left-hand man；Jazz 是 Shiv 的 right-hand 兼 mate——没有 Shiv 她无法离开监狱，且只能吸食 Shiv 的血。
Grayson Darke 是 incubus king，与 Dante 和 Jazz 基本是家人。
Jazz 是 siren queen；狱中叫 Jazz，外界多叫 Jasmine。
Shiv 是未堕落天使，试过数百次堕落都没挺过痛苦。

facts.fact: 吸血鬼咬人即算见血，罚关十二小时禁闭。
facts.anchor: Solitary confinement. Twelve hours there is the consequence for drawing blood.

facts.fact: Dante 听出背包里的玻璃声，得知 Ophelia 把陶器带进监狱。
facts.anchor: You carried pottery into a prison full of deadly immortal psychopaths?

facts.fact: Ophelia 交底：有人派她来救 Dante 和 Jazz，陶器是工具。
facts.anchor: Someone sent me to get you and Jazz out of here. The pottery is supposed to help.

facts.fact: Dante 亮明：Jazz 是 Shiv 的 mate，没有他走不掉、只能吸他的血。
facts.anchor: And she's his mate. She can't leave this place without him. He's the only person she can feed on.

facts.fact: 得知 Shiv 是天使后 Ophelia 强压恐慌——内阁被严令不得关押天使。
facts.anchor: The Cabinet was under strict orders not to put angels into the prison, and they did their own thing in our city, anyway.

facts.fact: Dante 甩出已被关十二年，逼 Ophelia 展翅验明身份。
facts.anchor: I've been locked in this hellhole for twelve fucking years, and we both know you're not a pixie.

facts.fact: Ophelia 放出黑灰紫翅膀，Dante 问她何时堕落。
facts.anchor: My feathers weren't white and silver, like most angels'. They were black, dark gray, and deep, dusty purple.

facts.fact: Dante 从她翅膀抠出干陶土；她承认陶器存着魔力、几乎全部魔法封在监狱里。
facts.anchor: I did. It's storing some of my power. Almost all of my magic lives in the prison, so I can't access it.
